title: Macrocyclic membranes: from liquid to solid state
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,7377-7420
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00100E, Tutorial Review
Lei Yang, Cheng-Yu Zhang, Hao-Ling Zhang, Qing-Yang Zhang, Jong Seung Kim, Yue Sun
Macrocyclic membranes represent transformative separation platforms with tunable structures. This review examines design advances, assembly mechanisms, and applications while addressing current challenges and future directions.
